jobs.name: Dogs Portrait Classic
jobs.prompt: 16-bit pixel art, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Square social media graphic. Large bold game title 'DOG TRAVEL' at top in pixel font with lime #baf122 glow. Subtitle 'by Hack Your Way' below in clean geometric sans-serif font. Two dogs sitting together in center as main heroes: golden retriever Max with friendly happy expression, and cream-white border collie Kesu with white blaze on face, alert expressive eyes. Dogs wearing lime green bandanas. Purple #5e17eb gradient background with subtle pixel stars. Color palette: lime #baf122, red #ff3131 accents, purple #5e17eb. Clean iconic composition.

jobs.name: Adventure Dogs
